profile.name: Artem Musatenko
about: Backend developer working mostly in Kotlin and Java: Ktor and Spring on the server, coroutines everywhere else, PostgreSQL and Docker around them.
Outside of work I build Minecraft plugins and mods used on public servers, and small Kotlin Multiplatform tools that I actually need myself.

experience.title: Backend developer
experience.description: Backend services in Kotlin and Java.

experience.title: Minecraft plugin developer
experience.description: Plugins and mods for Paper/Spigot servers, published on SpigotMC, Hangar and Modrinth. Server-side Kotlin, protocol level work, integrations with forum and auth systems.

education.title: Business Informatics
education.description: Studying business informatics: software engineering, data and product management.

projects.name: YouTubeCounter
projects.description: Desktop app showing likes and views of a running YouTube stream in real time, plus a small server that exchanges the Google auth code for an access token. CI packages it for Windows, macOS and Linux on every push.

projects.name: AuthMeIpsBridge
projects.description: Minecraft plugin linking an IPS forum with AuthMe Reloaded: a player registering in game automatically gets a forum account with the same credentials. Supports 1.8.x — 1.20.x.

projects.name: AuthServer
projects.description: Open-source Minecraft auth server core written from scratch in Kotlin — protocol handling, sessions and login flow without a vanilla server behind it.

projects.name: StackCrafter
projects.description: Minecraft mod that makes shift-click in the recipe book craft a whole stack at once instead of a single item.
